paragraphs.text: Gaea's Liege is an obsolete two-word creature type for an avatar of Gaea .

Gaea's Liege debuted as a creature type in Limited Edition Alpha on the eponymous card Gaea's Liege . It was physically reprinted with the type in subsequent core sets up through Fourth Edition . The type was later dropped in the Grand Creature Type Update , and it was given errata to be an Avatar . The original card was eventually reprinted with its new type line with the release of Time Spiral as a Timeshifted card as well as in the 30th Anniversary Edition . It was later released as a promotional card for the Wizards Play Network in Q4 of 2024 with new art.

Gaea's Liege was a Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods and an avatar of Gaea , the worldsoul of Dominaria . He appears as a male human with long hair, a long beard, and two antlers protruding from his head. He was called the "Spirit of the Forest" by Greensleeves and referred to as Gaea's Liege by Chaney . He would eventually be replaced by Greensleeves herself.
